notes:
EXPLORATION SUMMARY (10 min session):

CORE LOOP: Wake up (dream) → change to SchoolUni in Wardrobe → Living Room → Go out → Jecinda District (hub) → School → Class (Study/Study Hard/Slack off)

STATS SYSTEM (all start at 0):
- Corruption: determines what actions Zara can do (higher=more devious)
- Skills: Art, Science, Computer (for passing school)
- School Reputation: determines Prom Queen eligibility, joining 'dirty' activities
- Fitness: 1:1 scales max energy, struggle ability, walking energy cost, camming fans

RESOURCES:
- Energy (100/100 start, drained by actions)
- Money (200 start)
- Groceries/Snacks (5 each)

TIME SYSTEM: Hour/minute, day, dayOfWeek, weekDay/weekendDay, timeOfDay
Each passage transition: ~1 min. Outfit change: +5 min. Travel between districts: 10+ min.

CLASS MECHANIC (Art class confirmed):
- Study: -15 energy (gives +skill?)
- Study Hard: -30 energy (gives ++skill?)
- Slack off: -10 energy (probably corruption/rep)

GATES OBSERVED:
- Must wear SchoolUni to leave house (gate message: 'SHE NEEDS TO WEAR HER SCHOOL UNIFORM!')
- Dream choice: Accept=+1 Corruption, Reject=likely 0 corruption

DISTRICTS: Jecinda District (home), Arabella District (visible below). School is in Jecinda.

LOCATIONS MAPPED: Room (bedroom), Wardrobe, Living room, Jecinda District, School hallway, Classes (Art so far)

NPC ROSTER (10 chars, all object-based): dad, bro(Kyle), mom, dick, ben, jason, daniel, lisa, jessica, janet. Each has cooldownX and dailyHangX flags.

PROGRESSION GATES: school1stDayEvent, school2ndDayEvent (with Offer), school3rdDayEvent
Special systems: drugStatus, commissions(3), securityXIntro events, camming/drawing income, famSexUnlocked, curfew, allowance, chores

GOAL: Become Prom Queen by graduation. Get known, loved, respected. Many side paths.

Game is a sophisticated life-sim/corruption sandbox: calendar, time-of-day, 10 NPCs with objects (trust/love/corruption etc), income sources (art commissions, camming, allowance, chores), money sinks (gym, clothes, dildos), and layered progression gates.
